title: Global Supply Chain Transformation Intern
desc:
Discover Your Potential, Let Evyap Grow With You, Let You Grow With Evyap!
With more than 3,000 employees and export business to more than 100 countries, EVYAP’s success story started in a small atelier in Erzurum in 1927. Our trusted brands, including Duru, Arko Nem, Arko Men, Emotion, Blade, Activex, Evy Baby and Fax are loved worldwide. With facilities in Turkey, Egypt, and the world's largest oleo chemicals plant in Malaysia, we remain committed to innovation, sustainability, and creating value, all within a collaborative environment where our employees thrive.
We believe in becoming stronger together with you. Every new beginning is an exciting journey filled with fresh ideas and opportunities.
At Evyap, we share and respect, we are productive, responsible, and continuously improve ourselves. Here, you’ll find a world where you can grow, leave your mark through diverse projects, and thrive both personally and professionally. Together, we’ll grow and achieve greater success. Are you ready to embark on this journey with us?
Who We're Looking For?
3rd or 4th year student in Industrial Engineering, Management Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, MIS, Computer Engineering, Economics, Business Administration, or related fields,
Available to work at least 3 days per week,
Able to continue the internship for a minimum of 6 months,
Basic knowledge of SQL, Power BI, or data visualization tools is a plus,
Good command of English,
Good knowledge of Excel and other MS Office applications,
Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail,
Eagerness to learn data management processes and systems,
Strong communication and teamwork skills.
What You'll Be Doing?
Support the creation, maintenance, and validation of master data records,
Assist in monitoring data quality and ensuring compliance with data governance standards,
Participate in data cleansing, standardization, and improvement activities,
Support new product/material master data creation processes,
Perform data analysis and prepare reports to support business needs,
Collaborate with different departments to collect, verify, and maintain accurate data,
Contribute to digitalization and process improvement projects,
Prepare documentation and support the continuous improvement of master data processes,
Assist in identifying data inconsistencies and proposing improvement opportunities.
The Opportunities of Joining Us:
At Evyap, you're not just working, you're becoming part of a global organization. As a member of an internationally recognized company, you'll experience the excitement of shaping new ideas and driving innovation across continents. Here, your growth, creativity, and contributions are truly valued, offering you the unique opportunity to be part of our global success and benefit from the strength of Evyap. Some of our advantages are:
💻 Hybrid Working:
At Evyap, we offer our employees the flexibility to work from the office 3 days a week and from home 2 days a week. We make office days even more enjoyable with social events and special day celebrations.
🌍 Global Opportunities:
Work as an expat in offices across Indonesia, Malaysia, Russia, the USA, and Egypt, with opportunities to be part of international projects.
🚀 Learning & Development:
Enjoy monthly #TekİşimGelişim events, including webinars, digital training, and fun challenges to help you grow and have fun!
🎉 E-Joy Club:
Engage in social events covering music, art, sports, and social causes, connecting with your colleagues on different levels.
💼 Competitive Compensation:
Receive a competitive salary and strong union benefits, including holiday, shoe, fuel, and food allowances.D
🛍️ Flexible Benefits:
Customize your benefits through the Evystore app, choosing what suits your needs best.
🧴 Exclusive Products:
Experience our latest products with monthly gift packages and enjoy discounts at the on-site market.
If you want to grow in an innovative environment, build a career full of global opportunities, and be a part of Evyap, we are looking forward to your application.
The personal data collected as part of your job application is processed in accordance with the Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698. For detailed information regarding the processing of your personal data, please refer to the Applicant Privacy Notice at the link below:
